conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Payroll Compliance Division. This is Agent Carter. Can I help you?
Um, hi. I got a message about an issue with my business taxes? I don't really understand what's going on.
Yes, I see your name flagged in our payroll tax compliance system. The IRS has detected a critical error on your 1099 submissions for the last quarter. Are you aware of this situation?
No, I don't think so. I just started freelancing last year, and I'm still learning about all the forms.

Unfortunately, failing to submit accurate 1099 filings is a federal violation. These errors have triggered a pending federal audit against your business, with possible fines for intentional non-compliance.
Oh no, I didn't mean to do anything wrong. What kind of fines are you talking about?

If left unresolved, you could face penalties upwards of $8,000 for non-payment, and your business license may also be suspended. Additionally, the IRS can initiate asset freezes or refer your case for criminal review.
Wait, criminal review? I can't have anything like that on my record. My credit is already bad.

I understand this is overwhelming, but this is a serious matter. The only way to halt enforcement is to settle your outstanding tax obligations immediately. Do not attempt to contact anyone else, as your case is under active review.
What am I supposed to do? I don't have that kind of money.
Listen carefully. If you do not comply, the IRS will move forward with a lien on your assets and notify the Department of Justice. To prevent this, you must make a compliance deposit today.
Okay, but what is a compliance deposit? I don't really understand.

A compliance deposit is a temporary payment showing your intent to resolve the violation. The IRS requires this to stop the escalation and remove your case from criminal status. This must be sent using a secure method such as cryptocurrency or electronic transfer.
Cryptocurrency? I don't even have that. Can't I just pay with my card?

Unfortunately, for urgent compliance cases, the IRS only accepts payments through secure channels. I will provide you with a Bitcoin wallet address, or if you prefer, you may purchase prepaid gift cards from a local store.
I really don't know how Bitcoin works. I guess I could get gift cards if that's what I need to do.

Good. You need to purchase $2,000 worth of Apple or Target gift cards. Remain on the line while you go to the nearest store. Do not discuss this with anyone, or it could jeopardize your compliance status.
Wait, I'm not supposed to talk to anyone? Why?

If you involve third parties, it may be interpreted as obstruction. We need to resolve this directly and immediately to avoid further legal action. Please confirm when you are ready to leave for the store.
Okay, okay, I'm going to get my shoes on. Just please don't have anyone come to my house.
As long as you follow instructions, we can prevent enforcement teams from being dispatched. Once you have the gift cards, read me the codes on the back to process your payment.
Alright, I'm leaving now. I'm really scared. Is this going to be over after I do this?
Once we receive your compliance deposit, your case will be classified as resolved. If you fail to complete this, your file will be sent to federal authorities for immediate action.
